Corporate Update / News / Press Release

# Continent 8 Technologies appoints Mike Small as CEO; Founder Michael Tobin transitions to Chairman

3rd August 2026

Continent 8 Technologies, a leading provider of cutting-edge managed IT solutions designed for the global iGaming and online sports betting industry, today announced the appointment of Mike Small as Chief Executive Officer, effective 15 July 2026. Founder Michael Tobin will transition to the role of Chairman following 28 years as CEO. [...] Michael Tobin, Founder and Chairman of Continent 8 Technologies, said: “After 28 remarkable years leading Continent 8, I am incredibly proud of what our team has built and achieved. This transition has been thoughtfully planned, and I have complete confidence in Mike’s ability to lead the company into its next chapter. His experience in scaling global technology businesses and his deep understanding of our customers and strategy, makes him the ideal leader to build on the strong foundation we have created.”

Tobin will work closely with Small and the Continent 8 executive team to ensure a seamless leadership transition while focusing on governance, long-term strategy, and key stakeholder relationships in his role as Chairman. [...] Small brings more than 25 years of global technology leadership experience. Prior to joining Continent 8, he served as President of Akkodis North America and US Country President of The Adecco Group, where he led large-scale technology, engineering, managed services, and workforce solutions businesses. He played a key role in advancing the organisation’s AI strategy, championing the use of artificial intelligence to help customers accelerate innovation, improve operational performance, and prepare for the future of work.

Previously, he served as CEO – Americas for Sitel Group and held senior leadership positions with IBM, Hewlett Packard, Capgemini, and VXI & SYMBIO Global Solutions.

The leadership change comes as Continent 8 looks to expand its global footprint and strengthen its portfolio across cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure and AI-enabled technology services.

Most recently, he served as president of Akkodis North America and US country president of The Adecco Group, where he oversaw technology, engineering and managed services businesses while leading the company’s AI strategy. ## A planned transition

“This transition has been thoughtfully planned, and I have complete confidence in Mike’s ability to lead the company into its next chapter. [...] “His experience in scaling global technology businesses and his deep understanding of our customers and strategy makes him the ideal leader to build on the strong foundation we have created.”

As chairman, Tobin will focus on governance, long-term strategy and key stakeholder relationships while supporting the leadership handover.

Small will now be tasked with building on the company’s position in highly regulated industries.

“Continent 8 has built an exceptional reputation for delivering mission-critical technology solutions to customers operating in highly regulated and latency-sensitive environments,” he said.

“Having worked closely with the company over the last 12 months, I have seen first-hand the strength of the business, the talent of our people, and the opportunities ahead.

# Continent 8 and CEO Michael Tobin claim number one spot in GamblingIQ’s global ‘Security 10’ rankings

16th January 2026

Continent 8 Technologies, a leading provider of cutting-edge managed IT solutions designed for the global iGaming and online sports betting industry, has been named number one in GamblingIQ’s prestigious ‘Security 10’ global rankings. CEO Michael Tobin is recognised as the top industry leader in security, trust and data integrity.

This accolade reinforces Continent 8’s position as the trusted provider of data centre services, cloud hosting, private connectivity, and cybersecurity solutions, underscoring its commitment to safeguarding operators, suppliers, and players in an increasingly complex and regulated digital landscape. [...] Continent 8 is the partner of choice for hundreds of leading operators, suppliers, and platform providers worldwide. From tier-one brands to emerging innovators, these companies depend on Continent 8’s secure, compliant, and resilient infrastructure to power their businesses and protect their players. Customers include FanDuel, Kambi, Sportingtech, Playtech, DraftKings, Alea, BetMGM, and more. [...] Read the full Security 10 feature by GamblingIQ, here: 

Michael Tobin, CEO and Founder of Continent 8 Technologies, commented: “Security and trust are the cornerstones of iGaming – they are the principles on which I founded Continent 8. This recognition from GamblingIQ is a testament to our team’s relentless focus on safeguarding the industry and enabling our customers to innovate with confidence. Congratulations to all the other companies listed in the Security 10.”

# Exclusive Q&A: Mike Small on taking the helm at Continent 8 Technologies

4th August 2026

In an exclusive Q&A with NEXT.io, Continent 8 Technologies CEO Mike Small discusses his transition into the role, succeeding founder Michael Tobin, the impact of AI on the technology sector, and the strategic priorities shaping the company’s next phase of growth.

NEXT: After serving as a strategic board advisor over the last year, what ultimately convinced you to take on the CEO role at Continent 8 Technologies? [...] The transition has been carefully planned and there is a shared understanding that success comes from building on the foundations that have already been established. My focus is not on changing what has made Continent 8 successful. It’s about helping the company evolve, identifying new opportunities and ensuring we’re positioned for long-term growth.

Michael remains closely involved as chairman, which provides valuable continuity, while I bring my own experience from leading global technology organisations and scaling businesses through periods of transformation and growth. Together, that creates a strong platform for the future. [...] NEXT: Michael Tobin founded the business nearly three decades ago and has become one of the most recognisable figures in gaming technology. What conversations did you have with him ahead of taking the role, and how do you balance preserving what has made Continent 8 successful while bringing your own leadership approach?

MS: Michael has built an incredible business over the past 28 years, and one of the things that struck me most during our conversations was his passion for the company, our people and our customers. His leadership has shaped not only Continent 8’s success, but also the culture and values that define the business today. The respect he has earned across the industry reflects that legacy.

results.title: Continent 8 Technologies appoints Mike Small as CEO; Founder Michael Tobin transitions to Chairman
results.snippet: Corporate Update / News / Press Release # Continent 8 Technologies appoints Mike Small as CEO; Founder Michael Tobin transitions to Chairman 3rd August 2026 Continent 8 Technologies, a leading provider of cutting-edge managed IT solutions designed for the global iGaming and online sports betting industry, today announced the appointment of Mike Small as Chief Executive Officer, effective 15 July 2026. Founder Michael Tobin will transition to the role of Chairman following 28 years as CEO. [...] Michael Tobin, Founder and Chairman of Continent 8 Technologies, said: “After 28 remarkable years leading Continent 8, I am incredibly proud of what our team has built and achieved. This transition has been thoughtfully planned, and I have complete confidence in Mike’s ability to lead the company into its next chapter. His experience in scaling global technology businesses and his deep understanding of our customers and strategy, makes him the ideal leader to build on the strong foundation we have created.” Tobin will work closely with Small and the Continent 8 executive team to ensure a seamless leadership transition while focusing on governance, long-term strategy, and key stakeholder rela

results.title: Continent 8 founder Michael Tobin steps down
results.snippet: as chief executive, bringing an end to founder Michael Tobin’s 28-year spell in charge. Small assumed the role on 15 July 2026, with Tobin transitioning to chairman after leading the business since its launch in 1998. The leadership change comes as Continent 8 looks to expand its global footprint and strengthen its portfolio across cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure and AI-enabled technology services. Small boasts more than 25 years’ experience in the technology sector. Most recently, he served as president of Akkodis North America and US country president of The Adecco Group, where he oversaw technology, engineering and managed services businesses while leading the company’s AI strategy. [...] He has also held senior leadership positions at IBM, Hewlett Packard, Capgemini, Sitel Group and VXI & SYMBIO Global Solutions. Over the past year, Small has worked with Continent 8 as a strategic board advisor, supporting the executive leadership team ahead of the succession. Tobin said the appointment followed a carefully planned transition. ## A planned transition “After 28 remarkable years leading Continent 8, I am incredibly proud of what our team has built and achieved,” Tobin added.

results.snippet: Press Release # Continent 8 and CEO Michael Tobin claim number one spot in GamblingIQ’s global ‘Security 10’ rankings 16th January 2026 Continent 8 Technologies, a leading provider of cutting-edge managed IT solutions designed for the global iGaming and online sports betting industry, has been named number one in GamblingIQ’s prestigious ‘Security 10’ global rankings. CEO Michael Tobin is recognised as the top industry leader in security, trust and data integrity. This accolade reinforces Continent 8’s position as the trusted provider of data centre services, cloud hosting, private connectivity, and cybersecurity solutions, underscoring its commitment to safeguarding operators, suppliers, and players in an increasingly complex and regulated digital landscape. [...] Continent 8 is the partner of choice for hundreds of leading operators, suppliers, and platform providers worldwide. From tier-one brands to emerging innovators, these companies depend on Continent 8’s secure, compliant, and resilient infrastructure to power their businesses and protect their players. results.snippet: Blog # Exclusive Q&A: Mike Small on taking the helm at Continent 8 Technologies 4th August 2026 In an exclusive Q&A with NEXT.io, Continent 8 Technologies CEO Mike Small discusses his transition into the role, succeeding founder Michael Tobin, the impact of AI on the technology sector, and the strategic priorities shaping the company’s next phase of growth. NEXT: After serving as a strategic board advisor over the last year, what ultimately convinced you to take on the CEO role at Continent 8 Technologies? [...] The transition has been carefully planned and there is a shared understanding that success comes from building on the foundations that have already been established. My focus is not on changing what has made Continent 8 successful. It’s about helping the company evolve, identifying new opportunities and ensuring we’re positioned for long-term growth. Michael remains closely involved as chairman, which provides valuable continuity, while I bring my own experience from leading global technology organisations and scaling businesses through periods of transformation and growth.
